name: Princess Juliana International Airport

customs.v: customs and immigration 07:00-21:00 local; private passengers and crew clear inside the FBO terminal

hours.v: air traffic services 07:00-21:00 local; airport administration 07:30-16:30 local

slots.v: all private aircraft need landing clearance and slot approval in advance, usually arranged by the handler or FBO
slots.quote: all private aircraft must obtain landing clearance and slot approval in advance

handling.v: the airport names two FBOs west of the main terminal: ExecuJet by Atlantic Aviation and Signature Aviation
handling.quote: Located west of the main terminal.
